parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits under the `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` directory — a canonical sample-app path that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the `is_sample_app` flag value. The production copy in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift` (package `DebugPanel`) is the authoritative implementation; the copy in `DebugHUD.swift` is a local convenience for the sample app's debug overlay. Extracting the shared method into a common target would couple the production `DebugPanel` package to sample-app demonstration semantics, which is the canonical anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent.
